Chapter 6662: Unavoidable Tribulation

Chapter 6662: Unavoidable Tribulation

She hasn’t exuded any immortal dao yet despite the incoming peril. Nevertheless, they viewed her as a crownless king.

“Buzz.” All the golden light in the world engulfed her, forming a massive maelstrom spiraling around her ascent.

Although it looked incredible, everyone else watched in horror. She looked to be the master of this maelstrom but in reality, she was its prisoner. If this continued, it would join with the ocean of lightning above.

“Crackle!” The thunderous detonations from the ocean still reached cultivators’ ears.

“Boom!” A particular one illuminated Three Immortals.

“Damn!” Everyone was scared out of their mind, feeling so feeble before the lightning bolts.

Some emperors and desolate gods dropped to the ground while others lost their balance.

“Life and death, for living beings’ sake...” She chanted an ethereal mantra and became far removed from this world.

Alas, the tribulations still caught up and launched the first assault. These bolts could pierce through supreme overlords.

The sheer number and power made defense impossible, hence the inevitable wounds.

“Boom!” The golden maelstrom caught her again while the ocean of tribulation intensified, sending different types of bolts at her.

More and more tribulations emerged in the ocean. The size became massive, the largest domain beneath the high heaven.

No one had seen a tribulation domain of this scale, not even Bao Pu. The high heaven became the source of this punishment, intending to finish the task.

The ocean accommodated the influx of lightning bolts and tribulation flames. One became ten, ten became a hundred, and a hundred became a thousand...

Her supreme skills weren’t enough to stop all the bolts. For a regular cultivator, blocking one bolt required all of their attention. Surviving one wave often meant surpassing the tribulation.

However, her tribulation was infinite.

“A punishment.” Everyone saw the difference clearly at this point.
